tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Plural Futures paper; warm ink in dark.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Alternate section (sand). Keeps the page rhythm without rules.

tokens.name: paper-3
tokens.usage: Cool alternate section. Use sparingly, for the method and register areas.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Lifted card, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and full rules. 15.9:1 on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text, Mono labels, the endorsement. 7.5:1 on paper, 10.5:1 on dark.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and captions. Darkened from Plural Futures #8C7B73 (3.8:1) to pass: 5.1:1 on paper, 4.6:1 on paper-2, 6.1:1 on dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between items, gridlines. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Card outlines, stronger hairlines.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: NOW, full strength. Signature ink: the mark, fills, large areas, chart lines on dark. Too light for text or thin lines on paper (2.0:1).

tokens.name: sky-ink
tokens.usage: NOW, text-safe. Evidence lines, latest figures, Now labels, links, focus ring. 5.7:1 on paper, 5.4:1 on sky-wash; 10.1:1 on dark.

tokens.name: sky-wash
tokens.usage: NOW, ground. Behind the Now column and latest-figure callouts.

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: Text and lines on a sky fill. 8.1:1.

tokens.name: loam
tokens.usage: THEN, full strength. The report's path in charts and the quote rule. 4.4:1 on paper: graphics only.

tokens.name: loam-ink
tokens.usage: THEN, text-safe. In the report labels, quoted page references. 7.2:1 on paper, 6.3:1 on loam-wash; 10.2:1 on dark.

tokens.name: loam-wash
tokens.usage: THEN, ground. Behind the In the report column and report tiles.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Call to action fill, one per screen at most. Never in data or status. Ink text on it (5.2:1).

tokens.name: ember-ink
tokens.usage: Call to action text or outline. 4.5:1 on paper; 6.9:1 on dark.

tokens.name: bloom
tokens.usage: Scenario ink. Fills and bands only.

tokens.name: bloom-ink
tokens.usage: Scenario ink for lines and labels. 5.1:1 on paper.

tokens.name: sprout
tokens.usage: Scenario ink. Fills and bands only.

tokens.name: sprout-ink
tokens.usage: Scenario ink for lines and labels. 5.3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: scenario-wash-1
tokens.usage: Ember scenario card ground.

tokens.name: scenario-wash-2
tokens.usage: Bloom scenario card ground.

tokens.name: scenario-wash-3
tokens.usage: Sprout scenario card ground.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px ring outside a 2px paper gap.

tokens.name: spectrum-soft-1
tokens.usage: Stop 1 of the Plural Futures spectrum-soft. Scenario range band, cover and home hero only. Never behind text.

tokens.name: spectrum-soft-2
tokens.usage: Stop 2 of the Plural Futures spectrum-soft. Scenario range band, cover and home hero only. Never behind text.

tokens.name: spectrum-soft-3
tokens.usage: Stop 3 of the Plural Futures spectrum-soft. Scenario range band, cover and home hero only. Never behind text.

tokens.name: spectrum-soft-4
tokens.usage: Stop 4 of the Plural Futures spectrum-soft. Scenario range band, cover and home hero only. Never behind text.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Report name in the page header.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Growth holds; the jobs goal is behind its path
styles.usage: The tip, when set as the page's first line. Action title.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: Three of five key assumptions hold so far

styles.name: h3
styles.sample: Labour supply keeps pace with demand

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: The plan aimed to make the country a high-income economy by 2045.
styles.usage: The At a glance summary; first paragraph of a section.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Growth averaged 5.0% a year in 2023 to 2025, against the 6% the report assumed.
styles.usage: All reading text. Measure 60 to 72 characters.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Card bodies, table cells with prose. Phone minimum.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: A country that is sovereign, advanced, just and prosperous.
styles.usage: The report's own words, with a loam rule and a page reference.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Overlines, status words, Then and Now labels. Uppercase.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Figures in tables and chart labels. Tabular, right-aligned in tables.

styles.name: source
styles.sample: Source: INE, EPA Q3 2026 · as of 24 Oct 2026
styles.usage: Source and date lines under every claim and chart.
